The '''First Battle of Nyriaan''' was a battle that was fought on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], as part of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. With the help of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]], the Confederacy was able to emerge as the victor, and it gained control of the world. The Republic's holdings on Nyriaan were subsequently divided up by the CSA and the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]], and Nyriaan remained in the hands of the Confederacy until the [[Second Battle of Nyriaan]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].
